name: Noibu
description:
The Noibu connector gives merchants a turnkey way to ask "why" questions about their online store; traffic, behavior, conversion, performance, and errors, directly inside Claude, and act on the answers without leaving the conversation.

Once connected, Claude has live, read access to the merchant's Noibu data: sessions, page visits, customer journeys, conversion funnels, heatmaps and scrollmaps, session replays, JavaScript and network errors, Core Web Vitals, marketing attribution, and release events. Teams ask questions in plain English: "why did mobile checkout drop last week?", "which campaigns send bouncing traffic?" — and get answers grounded in their actual store data, not generic AI guesses.

Key features:
* Ecommerce-native data model — funnels, cart abandonment, checkout drop-off, PDP/PLP performance, AOV, and revenue per session are first-class concepts, so answers map to real business questions.
* Full-funnel analytics on demand — conversion rate, bounce rate, revenue, payment and delivery method mix, drop-off between any two funnel steps, segmented by device, country, channel, campaign, or custom attribute.
* Technical health diagnosis — priority errors ranked by impact, AI-assisted diagnoses, source-mapped stack traces, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) per page, so teams go from symptom to root cause in one conversation.
* Rich inline visuals — interactive click/scroll heatmaps, conversion-funnel charts, and session-replay video rendered directly in the conversation.
* Scoped write actions — Claude can update issue workflow states (e.g., mark an error fixed or ignored) and log release events, only when explicitly asked. Everything else is read-only; no settings, billing, or configuration access.
* Privacy by design — PII is masked/removed at ingestion into Noibu, so no personal shopper data can be retrieved through the connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Noibu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Noibu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.noibu.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Noibu MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noibu lists 32 MCP tools, including noibu_check_data_connection, noibu_create_release, noibu_discover_custom_events, noibu_get_business_context, noibu_get_company, noibu_get_current_user, noibu_get_domain, noibu_get_error, noibu_get_error_diagnosis, noibu_get_error_trends, noibu_get_issue_top_session_highlights, and noibu_get_log_groups_time_series.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Noibu?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Noibu in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Noibu requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Noibu is developed by Noibu. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
